summary: Iter 18 — Mobile polish audit at 390x844 (iPhone 12 Pro) with desktop smoke at 1280x900. Attached demo_pro cookie (extended expiry; session_token was expired at 2026-09-23 vs current date 2026-10-07 — refreshed via mongo). Verified all P0+P1+P2 mobile items: hub 2x2 stat chips + 4x1 on desktop, hub PTR banner responds to synthetic touchmove, schedule view toggle (default list on mobile, grid on desktop, persisted in ctp_schedule_view_v1), bottom-sheet modals (Crew Builder, Redeem, Feedback) via .dialog-sheet-panel on mobile and centered on desktop, Equipment snap-tabs with min-w-[88px] + tap-44, Workbook SheetTabs + scroll-fade-right, ExcelHeader short label 'CT Workbook' on mobile, RigSelector short 'Rig' label, global touch-action:manipulation on buttons, 16px font on inputs/textarea/select (iOS auto-zoom guard), safe-area utility classes present. Desktop smoke: /hub /schedule /treatment /app /team /equipment all render without pageerrors. One minor UX gap: pasting em-dashes in redeem field does NOT normalize to hyphens visually (backend-side strip works but display stays em-dashed).

minor.issue: Demo session_token in /app/memory/test_credentials.md was EXPIRED (expires_at 2026-09-23, container date 2026-10-07). Had to extend in Mongo to proceed. Future testers will hit the same wall — recommend regenerating with a longer expiry or storing a renewal step in test_credentials.md.

ui_bugs.issue: Input onChange only calls .toUpperCase() on raw value. Pasting 'ct—qxvg—tllk' (em-dashes) renders as 'CT—QXVG—TLLK' in the field — em-dashes are NOT visually normalized to ASCII hyphens as the spec expects. The redeem() handler at line 31 strips to alnum before POST, so submission still succeeds; this is strictly a display/UX bug.

Mobile viewport (390px) has 4px horizontal overflow — document.scrollWidth=394. Only offender is the hamburger menu button (class 'p-2 -mr-1 hover:bg-white/10 rounded tap-44', width 44px, right-edge at 394). Likely because tap-44 min-width:44px + -mr-1 negative margin + padding pushes beyond the safe-x inset. Not user-visible scrolling but fails strict 'no horizontal scroll' assertion.

issues: Could not directly read [data-sonner-toaster] attribute because Sonner only mounts the wrapper when the first toast fires. ResponsiveToaster component code at App.js:236 is correct (window.innerWidth<640 → top-right, else top-center, with resize listener). Needs a reliable toast trigger during test to assert data-y-position via DOM.

action_items: RedeemDialog: strengthen onChange normalization to strip non-[A-Z0-9] chars and auto-insert hyphens so the field displays 'CT-QXVG-TLLK' as the user types. Current behavior only uppercases.
Investigate 4px mobile horizontal overflow caused by the ExcelHeader hamburger button — likely tap-44 min-width conflicting with the -mr-1 negative margin + safe-x padding at 390px.
Regenerate the demo session_token with a long expiry (e.g. +365 days) and update /app/memory/test_credentials.md, OR document a one-liner to refresh it before each testing pass.
critical_code_review_comments: RedeemDialog.jsx line 76 — onChange logic (`e.target.value.toUpperCase()`) is inconsistent with the aggressive normalization that happens later at line 31. User sees em-dashes in the field even though server-side gets stripped. Move normalization into onChange so display matches what gets sent.

Hub.jsx scroll container (line 110) is `<div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto ..." ref={pullRef}>` — the spec's test matrix refers to a data-testid='hub-scroll'. Adding that testid would make the PTR assertion trivially robust in future tests.

ResponsiveToaster at App.js:236 reads window.innerWidth only on mount + resize, which is fine, but the Sonner <Toaster/> only renders the data-sonner-toaster DOM element lazily on first toast. Any UI test that asserts data-y-position must fire a real toast first (not just inspect DOM at idle).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile polish is largely in place. Two tiny UX gaps remain: (1) RedeemDialog display normalization doesn't collapse em-dashes to hyphens, and (2) a 4px horizontal overflow on mobile hub from the hamburger button. ResponsiveToaster correctness could not be fully asserted via DOM because [data-sonner-toaster] is mounted lazily — if the main agent wants a hard assertion, write a test that triggers a toast and polls for the wrapper. Also remember: the demo session_token expires — refresh it before running the next pass (one mongo update_one on user_sessions).
rca of the issue: Redeem em-dash: the input's onChange only applies .toUpperCase() to the raw string; the hyphen/em-dash normalization logic (strip + reformat) lives inside the redeem() submit handler and never runs during typing. Fix: factor out `normalizeInvite(raw)` and call it from both onChange and redeem(). Mobile 4px overflow: the hamburger .tap-44 button (min-width:44px forced by the tap-44 utility) plus the -mr-1 negative margin on the ExcelHeader button container exceeds the safe-x padded width at 390px.
